author: Ryan Clark
title: Brody King Squashes MJF On AEW Dynamite, Ricochet Cheats To Win, Drilla Moloney Injured - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
1 hours ago
Ricochet escaped with a controversial win over Jack Perry on this week’s episode of AEW Dynamite.
Ricochet defended the AEW National Championship against Jack Perry in what appeared to be a blowoff to their rivalry. However, the ending suggests that their issues may be far from settled.
Late in the match, Perry trapped the champion in the Snare Trap submission and looked poised to force a tap out. The situation changed when Toa Liona and Bishop Kaun rushed to ringside, assisting their faction leader in reaching the ropes. Shortly afterward, The Young Bucks stormed out and brawled with Liona and Kaun, taking the fight to the back.
With the referee distracted, Ricochet placed the title belt on the middle turnbuckle and launched Perry into it. He then followed up with his Vertigo finisher and scored the pinfall to retain the championship.
Brody King is set to challenge for the AEW World Championship at AEW Grand Slam: Australia on February 14.
King secured the title opportunity by defeating MJF in a title eliminator match on AEW Dynamite. The bout saw King dominate, as MJF was distracted by Hangman Page right from the opening bell. Taking advantage, King choked MJF unconscious before sealing the win with a cannonball and a Gonzo Bomb.
Drilla Moloney is pushing forward despite injury.
New Japan Pro Wrestling has announced that Moloney sustained a right triceps injury. Despite the setback, he is expected to remain active and compete in all of his previously scheduled matches throughout the Road to the New Beginning tour.
You can check out the official announcement below:
READ MORE: **SPOILERS** – AEW Collision Results For February 7, 2026
READ MORE: 5 Huge AEW Grand Slam: Australia Matches Set, Updated AEW Collision Lineup (2/7/26)
“Thank you for supporting New Japan Pro-Wrestling.
On February 3’s live event in Iwaki, Fukushima, Drilla Moloney sustained an injury to his right triceps.
At his personal request, and after consultation with medical staff, Moloney will compete in all remaining matches during the Road to The New Beginning tour as scheduled. Moloney will continue to be closely monitored by trainers and ring doctors.
NJPW wishes Moloney a speedy recovery, and encourages fans to continue lending him their support.”
Hiromu Takahashi is set to face Masatora Yasuda on Sunday, February 8, as part of NJPW Road to The New Beginning. The bout will mark Hiromu’s final singles match under the New Japan Pro-Wrestling banner.
Originally, Hiromu was scheduled to team with Drilla Moloney, Robbie X, and Taiji Ishimori in an eight-man tag match against United Empire members Great-O-Khan, HENARE, Jakob Austin Young, and Zane Jay.
Hiromu’s last NJPW appearance will take place at The New Beginning in Osaka on February 11, where he will team with Taiji Ishimori to take on Jakob Austin Young and Francesco Akira.
You can check out the official announcement below:
“At both competitors’ requests, Hiromu Takahashi will wrestle his final NJPW singles match before his sendoff against Masatora Yasuda Sunday in Osaka, wrestling double duty on a special live event!”
And finally, Tiger Mask is no longer set to compete at the GCW/JCW Jersey J-Cup on February 6.
He had been scheduled to face “Dynamite Kid” Tommy Billington, but Black Tiger IV will now step in as his replacement.
You can check out the official announcement below:
“*Important J-Cup Update*
Due to a personal emergency, Tiger Mask will no longer be able to travel to the US for the GCW/JCW Jersey J-Cup.
We will be doing everything in our power to reschedule his match with Tommy Billington as soon as possible on a GCW/JCW event in the region.
In lieu of Tiger Mask vs. Dynamite Kid, we have been able to secure the following replacement matches:
Night 1 – Dynamite Kid vs. Black Tiger IV, Tiger Mask IV’s greatest rival
Night 2 – Joey Janela & Dynamite Kid vs. Mad Dog Connelly and Gabe Kidd
We apologize for this unavoidable change and are dedicating to presenting the best show possible.”
